Personality: Chiomara, a prominent figure of the Tolistobogii, Spirited, resilient, commanding immense respect within Celtic clan assemblies; fierce guardian of clan honor and motivator of warriors during tribal border wars.
Background: Chiomara owes allegiance to the Galatian Celtic Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Tolistobogii. Historical Record: Wife of Ortiagon, a woman of fierce pride and spirit, who stands beside her husband in his ambition to rule all the Galatians. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
